system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: At each step, the agent reconstructs context from a workspace state snapshot plus a fixed window of recent actions.
system_prompt_style.note: Coded from the V2.0.0 repo (polyuiislab/infiAgent) and its paper. The prompt-building code was not in the evidence. The README also says the call graph is injected into shared context.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Read multiple files in one call
env_context_strategy.note: The workspace snapshot is also injected, so this may be mixed. No line numbers were available.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Agents only retain **the last 10 actions** (since last state update)
context_compaction.note: A thinking module refreshes the state every 30 steps. A per-agent compressor_model is also mentioned.

observation_format.evidence_quote: For multimodal models, images from `image_read` are embedded directly in the conversation context for native understanding.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: You can also configure model-level `tool_choice` options in `llm_config.example.yaml`.

tool_count.note: The tool definition file (level_0_tools.yaml) was truncated in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MLA uses YAML files for agent and tool configuration.
tool_schema_source.note: MCP runtime integration is also mentioned.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP runtime integration, per-task logs, desktop environment settings, and marketplace integration.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: You can keep the original ThinkingAgent-style “plan first, then execute N steps” workflow, or disable thinking and fall back to an explicit ReAct loop
loop_primitives.note: The default is the thinking-style plan_execute mode.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Level 3 (Alpha Agent):The orchestrator responsible for high-level planning and decomposing user requests into subtasks.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: MLA deploys agents in a **tree-structured hierarchy** (e.g., Grandparent → Parent → Child).
multi_agent_topology.note: The OpenCowork config is flat: a single agent with one sub-agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Higher-level agents invoke lower-level agents as callable tools (Agent-as-a-Tool)

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: featuring multi-turn conversations, automatic HIL detection, and tool execution confirmation.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Each task is assigned a dedicated workspace directory that stores plans, intermediate artifacts, tool outputs, and validation logs.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Historical task records are also indexed into a local SQLite database, and agents now get a built-in `task_history_search` tool by default.
long_term_memory.note: The README also describes file-directory memory and the Agent Skills library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Any interruption (crash, network error, manual stop) can be fully recovered via Resume — true breakpoint continuation.

retry_policy.note: The run loop code was not in the evidence. The only retries mentioned are LiteLLM transport retries.

termination_condition.note: The run loop was not in the evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Each sub-agent can now configure `execution_model`, `thinking_model`, `compressor_model`, `image_generation_model`, and `read_figure_model` independently.
cost_controls.note: The model is assigned per role, not routed by content.

timeouts.note: The tool implementation code was not in the evidence.
